title: MIT robot builds working laser cavity in 50 maneuvers under 30 minutes, self-corrects after disruption
summary_full: Massachusetts Institute of Technology researchers developed a robotic optics laboratory.  This system autonomously assembles and aligns laser cavities with precision.  The robot can also correct experimental setups after they are disturbed.  This technology could accelerate testing for various optical devices and materials.  Future applications envision remote interaction with these automated research environments.
